fib: ______ is the converse process of emission.
Absorption of light is the converse process of emission.
______ is used up in the excitation of atoms to higher energy states.
The lost energy is used up in the excitation of atoms to higher energy states.
______ refers to the correlation between the phases of two light waves travelling side by side.
Spatial coherence or transverse spatial coherence refers to the correlation between the phases of two light waves travelling side by side.
______ is known as LIDAR (light detection and ranging) and its operations are similar to those of a radar.
The technique is known as LIDAR (light detection and ranging) and its operations are similar to those of a radar.
______ is a distinct improvement over normal interferometry because the former can be used for any kind of material.
Holographic interferometry is a distinct improvement over normal interferometry because the former can be used for any kind of material.
